function: A CVAE generates initial AAV positions, excitation current weights and receiver choice for swarm distributed collaborative beamforming; MOALO then refines them for secrecy, sidelobe level and energy (pp. 7, 10).
system: Two swarms of 16 single-antenna AAVs form virtual arrays 5 km apart, A2A line-of-sight link, colluding ground eavesdroppers, 0.9 GHz; no RIS (pp. 5, 13).
method: Conditional VAE (linear layers, latent size 20), trained with reconstruction plus KL loss on archived Pareto solutions given environment factors; warm-starts ant lion optimizer (pp. 10, 13).
data_channel: Custom simulator: LoS A2A rate model and probabilistic-LoS eavesdropper channel (pp. 6, 13); CVAE trained on a dataset from 300 simulated problem instances; no 3GPP or measured data.
test_conditions: 300 training instances (varied AAV and eavesdropper positions); warm start applied to new instances; no other AAV count, area or band tested for the CVAE (pp. 10, 13).
baselines: Non-learned: LAA-Swarm (linear arrays, random receiver), MOGOA, MOMVO, MSSA, MODA, MOALO. Learned: none; own cold start is a variant (p. 13).
metrics: Minimum two-way known secrecy capacity f1 (bps), maximum sidelobe level f2 (dB), AAV energy cost f3 (J), Pareto fronts, execution time on Raspberry Pi (pp. 13, 16).
complexity: O(No N^2) for GenSI, O(N) CVAE sampling, O(Nd L z) CVAE training (p. 12); measured 65.26 s cold start, 26.98 s warm start on Raspberry Pi 4B (p. 16).
q1_support: p. 6: "the A2A transmission should follow a LoS channel condition"; eavesdroppers use a probabilistic LoS model (Eq. 4). Custom simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 13: "trained on a dataset derived from 300 problem instances"; p. 10 only says it serves "new optimization instances" of the same setup. No other scenario, AAV count or band is tested for the CVAE.
q3_support: p. 13: "state-of-the-art multi-objective swarm intelligence algorithms" (MOGOA, MOMVO, MSSA, MODA, MOALO) and LAA-Swarm are non-learned; no earlier learned method is compared, and the cold start is only a variant.
q4_support: p. 12: "the final time complexity of GenSI is" O(No N^2); p. 16: "completed within 65.26 s (Cold start case) or 26.98 s (Warm start case)".
q5_support: p. 13: "trained on a dataset derived from 300 problem instances", the authors' own simulated data; no code or data link, DOI or public dataset is given.
notes: Included, area 6. A trained CVAE generates AAV positions, excitation current weights and receiver choice for aerial distributed collaborative beamforming (pp. 7, 10), and MOALO refines them. Judgement calls for the reviewer: (1) the CVAE only warm-starts the swarm search, and the cold start without learning already beats the baselines (p. 13, Table 2: f1 2.14e6 vs 2.12e6 bps), so no_learning could be argued; (2) area 6 chosen over 3 because the link is aerial, by the specificity order; (3) q2 is 0 because the 'new instances' (p. 10) are new draws of one setup, not a different scenario. PDF is arXiv:2503.00721v1, a preprint; its title could not be matched to the DOI record.
